title: feat(nsqpz): nsopp z-probe PVM letter: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: PVM-letter readout: occupancy kernel n_mu = (o_{+mu} - o_{-mu})/3 from already-recorded neighbours, H = 3n . sigma with H^2 = kI, rank-1 projectors P_pm = (sqrt(k) I +/- H)/(2 sqrt(k)); the only member family touching the M_2(C) Qubit axiom. Reported HOLD/HOLD is vacuous: pvm_letters_from_n returns {+,-} whenever n != 0, so reverse_report's 'fail' branch is unreachable (I verified only {hold, UNDEFINED} are attainable) and HOLD means only 'n != 0 at both probes'.
